# Algoritmi

## Algoritmi di ordinamento confronto

### Insertion Sort

Inserisco il nuovo elemento nella posizione corretta
- a sinistra gli elementi sono già ordinati
- finché trovo elementi maggiori, continuo a spostare l'elemento a sinistra

```c
InsertionSort(A):
    for i <- 2 to A.length:
        key = A[i]
        j = i - 1
        while j > 0 and A[j] > key:
            A[j + 1] = A[j]
            j = j - 1
        A[j + 1] = key
```

### Merge Sort

```pascal
MergeSort(A,p,q){
    if (p < q){
        r <- (p+q)/2
        MergeSort(A,p,r)
        MergeSort(A,r+1,q)
        Merge(A,p,r,q)
    }
}
```

#### Merge (stabile, non inplace) - $\Theta (n)$

```py
Merge(A,p,r,q){
    B  new array[
    i <- p
    j <- j+1
    for (k <- 0 to B-length-1) {
        if (j > q) {
            B[k] <- A[i]
            i <- i+1
        } else if {
            B[k] <- A [j]
            j <- j+1
        } else if (A[i] < A[j]) {
            B[k] <- A[j]
            i <- i+1
        } else {
            B[k] <- A[j]
            j <- j +1
        }
    }
    for (k <- 0 to B.length-1){
        A[p+k] <- B[k]
        }
}
```

### Binary Search

```{.pseudocode}
procedure BinarySearch(A,p,q,k){
    if (p = q)
        return (A[p] = k)
    else
        r <- (p+q)/2
    end if
    if (A[r]= k)
        return 1
    else if (A[r] > k)
        return BinarySearch (A, p, r-1, k)
    else
        return BinarySearch (A, r+1, q, k)
    end if
end procedure
```

### HeapSort (non stabile, in-place)

Algoritmo con costo temporale $O(n \log n)$ 

```
procedure HeapSort(A)
    BuildHeap(A)
    for (i <- A.length down to 2)
        scambia (A, 1, i)
        A.heapsize <- A.heapsize -1
        Heapify(A,1)
    end for
end procedure
```

#### Heapify

costo temporale: $O (\log n)$

$$ T(n) = \begin{cases} \Theta (1), \quad n \leq \ \\ T(\frac{2}{3} n) + \Theta (1), \quad n \gt 1 \end{cases} $$

```c
procedure Heapify(H, i)
    l <- left(i)
    r <- right(i)
    if (l =< H.heapsize && H[l] > H[i])
        m <- l
    else
        m <- i
    end if
    if (r =< H.heapsize && H[r] > H[m])
        m <- r
    end if
    if (m != i)
        scambia (H, m, i)
        Heapify (H,m)
    end if
end procedure
```

| Left(i) | Right(i) | Parent(i) |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `return 2i`| `return 2i + 1`| `return floor(i/2)`|

### QuickSort

costo temporale

$$ T(n) = \begin{cases} \Theta (1), \quad n \leq 1 \\ T(m) + T(m-n-1) + \Theta (n), \quad n \gt 1 \end{cases} $$

```{.algorithm}
procedure QuickSort(A, p, q)
    if (p < q)
        r <- Partition(A, p, q)
        QuickSort(A, p, r-1)
        QuickSort(A, r+1, q)
    end if
end procedure 
```


#### Partition (Lomuto)

prende come perno l'ultimo elemento e ritorna la sua posizione corretta

```{pseudocode
#| label: alg-euclid
#| caption: Algoritmo di Euclide
\begin{algorithm}
\caption{Euclid}
\begin{algorithmic}
\Procedure{Euclid}{$a,b$}
\State $r \gets a \pmod b$
\While{$r \neq 0$}
  \State $a \gets b$
  \State $b \gets r$
  \State $r \gets a \pmod b$
\EndWhile
\State \textbf{return} $b$
\EndProcedure
\end{algorithmic}
\end{algorithm}
```
